name: Discogs: the older layout's #page_content left out
why: Submissions, a release's history and a user's ratings have no #app; their content is #page_content.

name: Discogs: a root list joined as one selector
why: '#app, #page_content a[href]' makes #app itself the match: closest() then returns the div, not the link. Run on the older layout since 2026-11-03: extRoot names main too (G4 of NON-MB-COVERAGE.org), and the React fixture's <main> inside #app turns the joined selector's last part into a match that hides the defect there; the submissions page has neither #app nor main.
